name: local-seo-skills
description: Open-source local SEO skills: GBP optimization, map pack visibility, audits, citations, reviews, keywords, geogrid analysis, AI visibility, multi-location SEO, reporting, and 15 scheduled task templates.

interface.longDescription:
Local SEO Skills turns ChatGPT into a local SEO specialist. 38 skills cover Google Business Profile optimization, map pack visibility, local SEO audits, citations and NAP consistency, review management, local keyword research, location and service-area pages, LocalBusiness schema, geogrid analysis, competitor analysis, AI search visibility, Apple and Bing listings, local PPC and Local Services Ads, multi-location SEO, and client reporting. 15 task skills set up recurring work as scheduled tasks: ranking and review monitoring, GBP change alerts, GBP post and review response drafts, citation and page audits, competitor snapshots, and weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports.

Skills give strategy and step-by-step workflows on their own. For live rankings, reviews, and audit data, connect a data plugin such as Local SEO Data, Ahrefs, Semrush, Local Falcon, or BrightLocal; tool skills explain how to use each one.

Built for agencies, consultants, and in-house marketers. Open source under the MIT license.
defaultPrompt: Run a local SEO audit for my business.
Why am I not showing up in the Google map pack?
Set up a weekly rankings monitor for my location.

publication.release_notes: Local SEO Skills 1.0.1: 38 skills and 15 scheduled task skills.
